targets.rawSql: SELECT properties->>'feature' as feature, COUNT(*) FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'personalization_fallback' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY feature

panels.title: AI Latency p50 / p90 by Feature

targets.rawSql: SELECT properties->>'feature' as feature, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (properties->>'latency_ms')::bigint) as p50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (properties->>'latency_ms')::bigint) as p90 FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'personalization_invoked' AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY feature
